novel_features.name: Name resolver
novel_features.description: Query races by year, class name, event name, and session type instead of chained UUIDs.
novel_features.rationale: The API only accepts chained seasonUuid/eventUuid/categoryUuid/sessionId; only a local resolution cache turns human names into those UUIDs.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Lets an agent answer 'who won the Dutch MotoGP race in 2024' in one call instead of four UUID lookups.

novel_features.name: Title race progression
novel_features.description: See how championship points evolved round-by-round across a season.
novel_features.rationale: Requires joining every round's classification locally; no single endpoint returns points-over-rounds.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Answers 'when did the title get decided' without pulling every race by hand.

novel_features.name: Head-to-head
novel_features.description: Compare two riders' career and season stats side by side.
novel_features.rationale: Aggregates career + per-season stats for both riders from the local store; no comparison endpoint exists.
novel_features.why_it_matters: One call to settle a rider-versus-rider debate with real numbers.

novel_features.name: Circuit history
novel_features.description: List winners at a given circuit across every synced season.
novel_features.rationale: Requires a multi-season join across events and classifications that no endpoint provides.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Surfaces track specialists and streaks an agent can't get from one API call.

novel_features.name: Rider career timeline
novel_features.description: Merge a rider's profile with career and season-by-season stats into one timeline.
novel_features.rationale: Combines profile + statistics endpoints and the local store into a single view.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Full career context in one command instead of stitching multiple endpoints.

novel_features.name: Since (what did I miss)
novel_features.description: Show finished events and winners for a season window.
novel_features.rationale: Time-windowed aggregation over finished events; no endpoint returns 'recent results'.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Fast catch-up on results without paging the whole calendar.

novel_features.name: Calendar ICS export
novel_features.description: Export a season calendar to an ICS file from the local store.
novel_features.rationale: Generates ICS offline from synced events; no API endpoint emits calendar files for arbitrary seasons.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Drop the race calendar straight into any calendar app, offline.

novel_features.name: Live timing snapshot
novel_features.description: Fetch the current live-timing feed as an agent-friendly JSON snapshot.
novel_features.rationale: Wraps the raw live-timing endpoint and reports a clean 'no active session' state instead of erroring when the feed is empty between sessions.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Lets an agent poll race state during a session and get a defined empty result otherwise.

narrative.headline: The first CLI and MCP server for MotoGP — human-friendly commands, offline SQLite history, and analyses no single endpoint provides.
narrative.value_prop: Query MotoGP, Moto2, and Moto3 results, standings, riders, and calendars by name instead of chained UUIDs. Every command resolves year, class, event, and rider names against the live API, and layered analyses — round-by-round title races, rider head-to-heads, and circuit histories — answer questions the official API can't in one call.

quickstart.comment: See available seasons and their UUIDs
Race classification resolved from human names, no UUIDs
How the championship points evolved over the first rounds
The season race calendar, or add --ics to export it

troubleshoots.symptom: A rider name is 'not found' or 'ambiguous'
troubleshoots.fix: Only current-season riders resolve by name; use full names to disambiguate brothers, or 'riders get <uuid>' / 'riders stats <legacy-id>' for retired riders.
The live-timing feed is only populated during an active session; expect empty output between sessions.
They replay many rounds live; bound them with --rounds N or --seasons N.

narrative.when_to_use: Reach for this CLI whenever an agent needs MotoGP, Moto2, or Moto3 facts: race winners, championship standings, rider stats, season calendars, or head-to-head comparisons. It is the right choice over a raw API call because it resolves human names to UUIDs and answers cross-season questions the API cannot.
